extraction_focus: Pay close attention to named datasets, tables, metrics with numeric values, data quality anomalies, named stakeholders and their requests, and tool or pipeline names. Extract schema details when mentioned.
compaction_preserve: Dataset and table names, metric definitions and current values, data quality issues with details, stakeholder requests with names and deadlines, pipeline and tool names.
compaction_compress: General SQL or coding explanations, repeated dataset background, meeting logistics.
